heading: A little about me
paragraphs: I'm Abhishek Thakur, a Web Designer currently working full-time at Gigsoft Pro.
In this role I design and build responsive websites for the company's international clients, using WordPress, Elementor, Beaver Builder, GoHighLevel, Square Online and related tools.
I also work with React, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS, so I can contribute on both the design and the front-end side of a product team.
